_source: Seljuk Arts of War Reference.txt (card text + integrated Background Book/errata clarifications). Each card: Event (upper) + Capability (lower); only one in effect at a time. 'side_wide' Capabilities (ALL) go to the board edge; 'this_lord' Capabilities attach to the Levying Lord (max 2 per mat, no duplicates). Phase 4 implements effects; this is data only.

tags_legend.treachery: adds the Treachery card to the Plan
tags_legend.this_campaign: effect lasts until end of Campaign/Season
tags_legend.immediate: resolve when revealed, return to deck

event.name: Flooded River Crossing
event.text: Alp Arslan undergoes Wastage 3 times (mark); if already marked, instead 1 Seljuk Lord -1 Lordship this Muster (Seljuk choice).

capability.name: Imperial Fortress Construction
capability.text: Place 2 Fort markers on this card (when Levied); as a Command action this Lord may place a Fort marker on an unfortified/Ruined Locale in the Roman Empire (removes a Seljuk Ruins there, adjust VP).

event.name: Mountain Ambush
event.text: HOLD: play in Battle if the Locale is adjacent to a Pass. Round 1, Roman Walls 1-3 vs Missiles.

capability.name: Oghuz Mercenaries
capability.text: Add the Oghuz Mercenaries special Vassal (2 Turkic Horse, S2) to this Lord's mat.

event.name: Summer Heat
event.text: HOLD: play in Summer after Seljuks reveal a Command card; that Lord is Command 1.

capability.name: Steeled Resolve
capability.text: This Lord's Infantry have Armor 1-3 vs Horse in any 1 Round of Battle (mark).

event.name: Sultan's Horse Is Killed
event.text: HOLD: where Alp Arslan Besieges with >1 Siege marker, remove 1 Siege; OR during Storm reduce Rounds by 1.

capability.name: Pressed Levy Service
capability.text: Romans may keep 1 Unpaid Thema's Levied Themata with a Lord at end of each Campaign.

event.name: Fatimid Conflict
event.text: Shift any 1 Seljuk cylinder or Service of an Unbesieged Lord 1 Calendar box (any direction, Roman choice).

capability.name: Norman Heavy Cavalry
capability.heraldry: Robert Crepin and Roussel de Bailleul
capability.text: This Lord may reroll 1 Norman Knights' Armor each Missiles step AND each Melee step.

event.name: Michael Attaleiates
event.text: HOLD: play on Romanos during Muster for Lordship +1.

capability.name: Centralized Administration
capability.heraldry: Any, except Chatatourios, Robert Crepin, Roussel de Bailleul
capability.text: This Lord beginning his activation inside the Roman Empire with a Supply Route gets +1 Command.

event.name: Basil Alousianos Tricks the Sultan
event.text: HOLD: as a Roman Stronghold Surrenders on a roll of 3 or less, do not place Conquered; replace all Siege with Bypass (mark). If marked, discard and draw new Event.

capability.name: Emperor's Retinue
capability.text: Add the Emperor's Retinue special Vassal (1 Varangian Guard, 1 Hetaireia, S1) to this Lord's mat.

event.name: Roman Persuasion
event.text: Add your Treachery card to this Season's Command Deck (Plan); Seljuk must add 1 No Command.

capability.name: Martial Society
capability.heraldry: Robert Crepin and Roussel de Bailleul
capability.text: This Lord is Command +1 (while Levied).

event.name: Winter Campaign
event.text: HOLD: play in Winter before Bounty to activate a Roman Lord (may be Besieged).

capability.name: Provincial Bureaucracy
capability.heraldry: Any Commander (Romanos Diogenes or Manuel Komnenos)
capability.text: This Lord's first Tax Command outside Constantinople each Campaign does not place Ravaged.

event.name: Afsin Murders Seljuk Officer
event.text: Afsin Beg's Fealty is 2 (mark); if already marked, instead 1 Seljuk Lord -1 Lordship this Muster (Seljuk choice).

capability.name: Reconquista & Sicilian Commanders
capability.heraldry: Robert Crepin and Roussel de Bailleul
capability.text: This Lord's Lordship +1 (while Levied).

event.name: Chrysoskoulos Counsels the Court
event.text: If Arisighi is a Roman ally, Seljuks discard 1 random Held card.

capability.name: Klibanophoroi
capability.text: This Lord's Tagmata have Armor 1-4 (vs Missiles and Melee; not for post-Battle Losses; while Levied).

event.name: Afsin Recalled
event.text: Shift Afsin Beg's cylinder or Service 1 Calendar box (Roman choice of direction).

capability.name: Empress Eudokia Makrembolitissa
capability.text: Make the Empress token available each Call to Arms (3.5.1.2). Board edge.

event.name: Thrakion Reinforcements
event.text: Return a previously-removed Themata Service Marker to its home Thema box.

capability.name: Syndosis
capability.text: This Lord's Militia have Armor 1-2 (vs Missiles and Melee; not for post-Battle Losses; while Levied).

event.name: Aleppo Independence
event.text: Unless Aleppo is Conquered, it becomes Friendly to both sides (mark); neither may Withdraw inside. Enables Seljuk Aleppo auto-victory (5.2).

capability.name: Imperial Coffers
capability.text: Discard during Arts of War if a Roman is adjacent to a Seljuk-allied Robert/Roussel: make 1 Loyalty Check vs that Lord. May not be Levied if neither is Seljuk-allied. Board edge.

event.name: Emir of Aleppo Spurns Alp Arslan
event.text: If Aleppo is Seljuk Conquered with no Siege marker, place Independent Aleppo; if already present, place Roman Conquered instead. Adjust VP (mark). If marked or no effect, discard and draw new Event.

capability.name: Fealty to the Basileus
capability.text: This Lord may choose not to return to Seat in Winter (may stay even if Besieging).

event.name: Anglo-Saxon Exiles
event.text: If available, add 1 Varangian Guard to any Roman Lord (not Robert/Roussel) who has none.

capability.name: Armenian Garrisons
capability.text: All Roman-Conquered Strongholds outside the Roman Empire use BOTH Seljuk and Roman Garrison units. Board edge.

event.name: Unpredictable Weather
event.text: This Campaign: if Spring/Autumn, Passes cannot be used for Supply/March/Avoid/Retreat; if Summer, Plan stack is 9 cards and Seljuk adds 1 No Command.

capability.name: Scholai
capability.text: Add the Scholai special Vassal (1 Hetaireia, S1) to this Lord's mat.

event.name: Local Scouts
event.text: HOLD: as Enemy Avoids Battle, Enemy chooses 1 Avoiding Lord to Battle or Withdraw instead.

capability.name: Icon of the Virgin Mary
capability.text: Discard when calculating Losses after Battle: this Lord's Routed units recover per Armor regardless of situation.

event.name: Resilient Agriculture
event.text: Remove 2 Seljuk Ravaged markers from the Roman Empire (mandatory, as many as possible).

capability.name: Nomisma Debased
capability.text: Discard during Pay (Levy) to shift all Roman Service 1 box; non-Commander Roman Lords may not Tax for rest of game (mark). Once per game. Board edge.

event.name: Armenian Resistance
event.text: If Khliat, Manzikert, or Arkesh is Seljuk-friendly, choose one and place Roman Conquered (adjust VP). If a Seljuk Lord is present there, Seljuk places a Siege or Bypass; if a Strategic Objective is there, return it to available.

capability.name: Siege Weaponry
capability.heraldry: Any, except Robert Crepin and Roussel de Bailleul
capability.text: This Lord, Unrouted at a Storm (incl. Reserve), reduces Enemy Walls -1.

event.name: Nomadic Tribes Go Rogue
event.text: HOLD: before Battle or Storm, remove up to 2 Turkic Horse units at the Active Lord's Locale from play (no recovery; may cause Disband).

capability.name: Bardoukia
capability.text: This Lord's Tagmata inflict -1 to target Armor during each Melee Strike step of Battle.

event.name: Assassination Plot in Tyre
event.text: Unless Ibn Khan within 2 Locales of Aleppo, permanently Disband him; otherwise shift his Service 1 box (Roman choice, may Disband).

capability.name: Cavalry Supply Line Raiders
capability.text: During Wastage, 1 Enemy Lord adjacent to This Lord undergoes Wastage twice (Roman chooses if multiple).

event.name: Kleisourai
event.text: HOLD: when a Seljuk Lord Marches/Avoids/Retreats across a Pass, each moving Seljuk Lord takes 1 Hit (as if in Battle; failed Protection eliminates with no recovery).

capability.name: Alakatia
capability.text: This Lord with >=2 Infantry in Battle adds 1 extra Missile Hit with -1 to target Armor (does not scale beyond 2).

event.name: Cavalry Charge
event.text: HOLD: on 1 Roman Lord in Battle, Round 1 that Lord's Horse Melee precedes all Missiles (skips its usual Melee). Takes precedence over Command Confusion.

capability.name: Mules
capability.text: This Lord's first March across a Pass each Command card spends only 1 Command even if Laden (not under Lieutenant/Group March).

event.name: Honors of War
event.text: HOLD: during a Siege on a Fort, instead of rolling the Fort automatically Surrenders; take no Spoils (active Lord must still take a Siege action).

capability.name: Psiloi
capability.text: Roman (non-garrison) Militia have Missiles x1/2. Board edge.

event.name: Surprise
event.text: HOLD: upon Besieging an enemy Fort/Town where no other Lord, place 2 Siege there (not 1), then Storm.

capability.name: Lamellar Armor
capability.heraldry: Emir of Arran, Alp Arslan, Artuk Beg
capability.text: This Lord's Turkic Horse have Armor 1-3 until 3 of them Rout (then off for the Battle); per Melee Hit may use Lamellar OR Evade. (Copy 1 of 2.)

event.name: Mountain Ambush
event.text: HOLD: play in Battle if the Locale is adjacent to a Pass. Round 1, Seljuk Walls 1-3 vs Missiles.

capability.name: Lamellar Armor
capability.heraldry: Emir of Arran, Alp Arslan, Artuk Beg
capability.text: Identical to S1 Lamellar Armor. (Copy 2 of 2.)

event.name: The Betrayal of Andronikos Doukas
event.text: HOLD: after the Reposition step in Battle, if more than one enemy Lord, move a non-Commander Roman Lord to Reserve (may rejoin later).

capability.name: Steppe Raiders
capability.text: This Lord may Ravage adjacent Locales (incl. across a Pass) where no enemy Lord, if he has Turkic Horse.

event.name: Summer Heat
event.text: HOLD: play in Summer after Romans reveal a Command card; that Lord is Command 1.

capability.name: Shock Tactics
capability.text: Half of this Lord's Turkic Horse (round up) have Melee x1/2. (Copy 1 of 2.)

event.name: Siege of Bari
event.text: Remove from play 2 Unlevied Themata (mark); if already marked, instead 1 Seljuk Lord +1 Lordship this Muster (Seljuk choice).

capability.name: Forced Conscription
capability.text: Each Muster phase, this Lord at an Unbesieged Friendly Locale may restore 1 of his Lost units (Vassal or original Force), beyond normal Muster actions.

event.name: Command Confusion
event.text: HOLD: on a Roman Lord in Battle, his Missiles and Melee each Strike second. Cavalry Charge takes precedence.

capability.name: Shock Tactics
capability.text: Identical to S4 Shock Tactics. (Copy 2 of 2.)

event.name: Deserters
event.text: Remove from play 1 Themata from a border Thema (Iberia, Mesopotamia, Melitene, Antiocheia), not one Levied to the Commander's mat.

capability.name: Trusted Commander
capability.heraldry: Emir of Arran, Artuk Beg, Sav-Tekin
capability.text: This Lord may March as a Commander with 1 (only) other Seljuk Lord (March only; not Commander status).

event.name: Caliphate Merchant Financing
event.text: 1 Seljuk Lord may exchange any of his Carts for Coin or vice versa (his own Carts only).

capability.name: Marwanid Alliance
capability.text: May spend Coin during Call to Arms to create special Seljuk Seats at Amid/Mayyafariqin (3.5.1.1). Board edge.

event.name: Alp Arslan's Moustache
event.text: This Campaign, Alp Arslan's Forage rolls -2 (Alp Arslan only).

capability.name: Imperial Rivalry
capability.text: Each Levy, Romans must attempt once to Muster Andronikos Doukas if Ready. Board edge.

event.name: Eastern Rebellions Defeated
event.text: HOLD: play on Alp Arslan during Muster for Lordship +1.

capability.name: Artukid Legacy
capability.text: This Lord may always use Mayyafariqin and Amid as Supply Source and for returning Loot during Bounty (himself only), regardless of Marwanid Alliance.

event.name: Norman Scheming
event.text: If Roussel or Robert is a Seljuk ally, Romans discard 1 random Held card.

capability.name: Javelins
capability.text: This Lord's Infantry have Missiles x1 in any 1 Battle Round (every Battle, not Storm).

event.name: Doukai Court Intrigues
event.text: Shift any 1 Roman cylinder or Service 1 Calendar box (any direction, Seljuk choice).

capability.name: The Sickle of Anatolia
capability.text: This Lord is Command +1 (while Levied; one extra action, not an All+1).

event.name: Peace Offering
event.text: This Season, no Approach/Storm/Siege unless that Lord pays 1 Coin that Command card. Adds Gifts Exchanged to Seljuk Levied Capabilities.

capability.name: Gifts Exchanged
capability.text: Muster only if Friendly and Enemy Lords adjacent. Put 4 Coin on card; Seljuks then Romans may each take up to 2 Coin onto an Unbesieged Lord. Discard at end of Season. Board edge.

event.name: Manuel Komnenos Falls Ill
event.text: Shift Manuel Komnenos's Service or cylinder 1 Calendar box (Seljuk choice of direction).

capability.name: Support from Aleppo
capability.text: This Lord is Command +1 on a die roll of 1-3 each of his Command cards. Discard if this Lord Ravages Aleppo.

event.name: Thematic Troops Desert
event.text: Alp Arslan in a Thema removes 1 Levied or Unlevied Themata Service Marker there (Seljuk choice; even Besieged).

capability.name: Nizam al-Mulk Administrates the Sultanate
capability.text: This Lord may choose not to return to Seat in Winter (may stay even if Besieging).

event.name: Norman Extortion
event.text: Add your Treachery card to this Season's Command Deck (Plan); Roman must add 1 No Command. Only one Treachery Event per Arts of War phase.

capability.name: Parthian Shot
capability.text: This Lord's Turkic Horse select targets during the Missile phase in Battle (not Storm).

event.name: Unpredictable Weather
event.text: This Campaign: if Spring/Autumn, Passes cannot be used for Supply/March/Avoid/Retreat; if Summer, Plan stack is 9 cards and Roman adds 1 No Command.

capability.name: Deep Raids
capability.text: In Call to Arms, Disband this Lord in Ikonion for 2 VP or Western Anatolia for 3 VP (place Loot in Mosul & Baghdad box).

event.name: Winter March
event.text: HOLD: play in Winter before Bounty to activate a Seljuk Lord (may be Besieged).

capability.name: Unstoppable Turkmen
capability.heraldry: Any, except Robert Crepin and Roussel de Bailleul
capability.text: Once per Command, this Lord may Bypass without stopping (Laden March still costs extra; Battle still ends the card).

event.name: Norman Pay Revolt
event.text: Add your Treachery card to this Season's Command Deck (Plan); Roman must add 1 No Command. Only one Treachery Event per Arts of War phase.

capability.name: Baghdad Reinforcements
capability.heraldry: Any, except Robert Crepin and Roussel de Bailleul
capability.text: Each Muster phase, this Lord at an Unbesieged Friendly Locale may restore 1 Lost unit (Vassal or original Force) for free (no Lordship).

event.name: Alp Arslan Consolidates Power
event.text: Lower this year's Seljuk Unity threshold by the number of permanently disbanded Seljuk Lords (mark).

capability.name: Elite Ghulam Cavalry
capability.heraldry: Any, except Robert Crepin and Roussel de Bailleul
capability.text: Add the Ghulam special Vassal (1 Ghulam, S1) to this Lord's mat.

event.name: Common Cultural Cause
event.text: HOLD: in Battle or Storm, remove up to 2 Turkic Horse Themata markers and/or Turkic Horse units at the Active Lord's Locale from play (may cause Disband).

capability.name: Brutal Reputation
capability.text: This Lord's Siege action may reroll 1 Surrender die (keep the new roll).

event.name: Massacre of Orthodox Clergy
event.text: A Seljuk Lord at an Enemy Locale adds 1 Loot (even if Besieged).

capability.name: Turkmen Skirmishers
capability.text: During Wastage, 1 Enemy Lord adjacent to This Lord undergoes Wastage twice (Seljuk chooses if multiple).

event.name: Reinforcements Denied
event.text: Shift 1 Roman Lord's Service 1 Calendar box (Seljuk choice of direction).

capability.name: Fortified Garrisons
capability.text: Each Roman Storm, replace 1 Garrison Militia with Infantry (once per Storm, at Array/Play Events). Board edge.

event.name: Bad Omens
event.text: HOLD: on a Seljuk Command card, inspect the top 2 Roman Plan cards and replace them in either order (immediately after revealing, before actions).

capability.name: Prisoners
capability.text: This Lord in Winter Bounty may return 1 Loot beyond his Carts (max 1 excess per Bounty).

event.name: Mercenary Discipline Falters
event.text: Each Roman Lord at a Ravaged Locale suffers Wastage now (friendly and enemy Ravaged markers).

capability.name: Mules
capability.text: This Lord's first March across a Pass each Command card spends only 1 Command even if Laden (not under Lieutenant/Group March).
